map.→ 打开温室通风量（换气次数）计算工具: -> Open the greenhouse ventilation (air changes) calculator tool
map.双坡屋面温室截面积按「矩形 + 三角形」拆分：檐高以下为矩形，脊高与檐高之差的一: For a gable-roof greenhouse the cross-section is split as "rectangle plus triangle": below the eaves it is a rectangle, and the triangle comes from half the difference between ridge height and eaves height. The required ventilation volume is the volume times the target air changes per hour; the ventilation per unit floor area = volume / floor area, used to check the air volume per unit area; enter the fan capacity of one unit and round up to estimate the theoretical number of fans.
map.夏季降温常需 30~60 次/h 换气，冬季维持 1~3 次/h 除湿。: Summer cooling usually needs 30-60 air changes per hour, while winter keeps 1-3 per hour for dehumidification.
map.夏季降温需要高换气，但冬季高换气会散热增耗、引发冷害。应随季节与作物调整，并配合: Summer cooling needs high air exchange, but in winter high exchange loses heat, raises consumption and can cause chilling injury. Adjust by season and crop, and use an insulated curtain alongside it.
map.截面积 = 宽 × 檐高 + 宽 × (脊高 − 檐高) ÷ 2；体积 = 截面: Cross-section = width x eaves height + width x (ridge height - eaves height) / 2; volume = cross-section x length; ventilation volume = volume x air changes; fan count = ceil(ventilation volume / airflow per fan)
map.换气次数越高越好吗？: Is a higher air change rate always better?

map.自然通风和机械通风怎么选？: How do you choose between natural and mechanical ventilation?
map.自然通风节能但受风压温差限制，适合春秋；夏季高温高湿地区机械（风机+湿帘）更稳。: Natural ventilation saves energy but is limited by wind pressure and temperature difference, so it suits spring and autumn; in hot humid summer areas mechanical ventilation (fans plus a wet pad) is steadier. Designs often combine the two.
map.通风量 = 温室体积 × 换气次数（次/h）。: Ventilation volume = greenhouse volume x air changes (per hour).
map.：温室体积 2000 m³，夏季目标换气 40 次/h，则所需通风量 = 200: : a greenhouse volume of 2,000 m3 with a summer target of 40 air changes per hour needs 2000 x 40 = 80,000 m3/h of ventilation. Two 40,000 m3/h fans meet it, and the wet pad face velocity should be checked.
